# Ole Thorlacius-Ussing

Ole Thorlacius-Ussing is an Overlæge (senior physician) with a medical doctorate (dr.med.) working in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] who serves as a steering committee member for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease. His role places him among the representatives from all five Danish regions, medical specialties (medicine, surgery, nursing), and patient advocates who guide the clinical and research direction of the database [^src1][^src2].

DANIBD, which Thorlacius-Ussing helps oversee, is a comprehensive national registry that tracks patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treated at Danish public hospitals. During the period from 1 October 2022 to 30 September 2023, the database documented treatment of 33,381 IBD patients across Denmark, with biological treatments (BMSL) administered to 10,523 of them [^src1]. Thorlacius-Ussing's participation in the steering committee reflects his clinical leadership role in Region Nordjylland's contribution to this national effort.

His continued membership in the steering committee was confirmed in both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports [^src1][^src2], indicating ongoing involvement in the governance and clinical direction of the database.
